_comment: Windsurf: ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json. Remove the _comment keys before use.

quiet._comment: --quiet drops the startup banner, for a tidier client log. Alarms and errors are still printed.

remote-through-the-proxy._comment: Run `mcp-audit serve --target https://example.com/mcp --listen 127.0.0.1:9000` separately, then point Windsurf here.
